# inscope audit - v0.13.0 (2026-07-09)

The single, current audit of the codebase. It consolidates and supersedes the
prior `2026-06-13` audit: every one of that audit's claims was re-verified against
the current code (results in "Prior audit status" below), so this one file is the
whole record.

Method: five parallel auditors (security, test coverage, architecture,
portability, UX/DX + docs), each grounded in source; the top security finding was
verified with a live exploit/patch check, and the prior audit's findings were
verified claim by claim.

## TL;DR

- The **`ext::` RCE (S1) and the keychain-quoting nit (S2) are already fixed** in
  PR #36 (verified with a live repro). The rest of the actionable items are
  tracked in issue #35.
- The **prior 2026-06-13 audit checks out**: its claims were accurate, and its
  headline items (any-branch npm publish, non-atomic writes, non-transactional
  apply, duplicated merge logic, raw JSON error, `zsh -n`) are all resolved.
- The **render / apply core is strong** (golden-pinned, injection-hardened,
  atomic writes). Remaining debt: the `bin/` layer (pure logic living there;
  `add`/`edit` duplication) and **diagnostic-tier test coverage** (`doctor`,
  `secrets`, `_prompt.ts`).
- **Portability is shallow-coupled**: one shell artifact (the hook) + one OS
  artifact (the Slack keychain). Linux + zsh is ~90% there.

## Strategic roadmap

1. **Security hardening** - S1 + S2 done (#36); nothing else HIGH.
2. **inscope MCP server** - expose the commands as MCP tools (the long-planned next capability).
3. **Linux + bash support** - secret backend first (unlocks Linux + zsh cheaply), then a bash hook generator (`chpwd` -> `PROMPT_COMMAND`), then fish.
4. **Diagnostic-tier tests** - `runDoctor` matrix + `unpinnedServers` + `secrets` wrappers + `_prompt.ts`; highest value-per-effort, all doable via the injectable `Runner`.
5. **Restore the src/bin boundary + de-dup `add`/`edit`** - removes ~100-150 lines.
6. **UX polish** - shell completions, `--json` for `doctor`/`list`, the doc-string bugs below.

---

## Findings by dimension

Severity is the auditor's; `file:line` is where to look. Nothing proposes a
runtime dependency (the project is deliberately zero-dep).

### Security & robustness

- **S1 - HIGH. Fixed in #36.** Config-supplied skill source RCE via git's `ext::`
  transport: `isGitUrl` (`config.ts`) accepted any `.git`-suffixed string and it
  reached `git clone`. Now `classifySkillSource` rejects the `name::` transport
  syntax and `ensureClone` runs clone/fetch with
  `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=https:http:ssh:git:file`. Verified: the payload fires
  without the guard and is refused with it.
- **S2 - MED. Fixed in #36.** `keychainSetCommand` interpolated the config
  `keychain` value unquoted into a copy-paste `security` command; now
  single-quoted (`secrets.ts`).
- **S3 - LOW-MED. `apply` is not atomic across files.** `applyAll` preflights
  `.mcp.json` but not isolated workspaces' `.inscope/settings.json`; a corrupt one
  throws mid-loop after earlier files are written (`apply.ts:57`). Fix: preflight
  settings.json too.
- **S4 - LOW. `writeFileAtomic` leaks the temp file on write/chmod failure**
  (`io.ts:46-56`). Core guarantee holds; wrap write+chmod+rename in one try.
- **R3 - LOW (carried from 2026-06-13). `keychainSet` passes the Slack token as an
  argv** (`secrets.ts:60-70`), briefly visible in `ps`. The `Runner` already
  supports `input:` (stdin) - pass the token that way instead.
- **R4 - LOW (carried). `ghToken` materializes the real token just for a boolean**
  presence check in doctor (`secrets.ts:29-33` used as a bool at `doctor.ts:210`).
  A presence-only variant would avoid handling it.
- **S5 - LOW. git email/name validation blocks CR/LF but not a trailing backslash**
  (`config.ts:186`); cosmetic (line-continuation), not injection.

Solid and verified: no `shell: true` anywhere; hook injection prevented
(`HOOK_UNSAFE` + double-quoting; the one unquoted `case` label is the slug name);
tokens never persisted (`.mcp.json` holds only env refs + a fetch-at-connect
helper); managed blocks unescapable; no path traversal.

### Test coverage

Strong core (golden-pinned generators, `zsh -n`, injection cases, config
validation). Gaps cluster in the side-effecting / diagnostic tier, all testable
via the injectable `Runner`.

- **T1 - highest value. `runDoctor` check branches + `unpinnedServers` unasserted**
  (`doctor.ts:37-53`, `:138-301`). A dropped/inverted check yields a false "All
  checks passed" - invisible. Add Runner-driven cases per branch.
- **T2 - `bin/commands/skill.ts` (512 lines) mostly untested** (reserved-name
  toggles, rename collision, resolver). Reuse the CLI-spawn-in-sandbox pattern
  (`test:1403`). Also: most bin commands (edit/remove/diff/doctor/apply/list) and
  **`_prompt.ts`** have no command-level tests (carried from F7).
- **T3 - `secrets.ts` keychain + gh/git wrappers: zero direct coverage** (`:29-82`).
- **T4 - `settings.json` malformed-JSON clobber guard untested** (`settings.ts:53`).
- **T5 - `config.ts` `skillSubdirError`: leading-`/` and newline guards untested** (`:222`).
- Minor: `renderStatus` never renders `snap.claude.org`; no no-servers/no-skills status golden.

### Architecture & simplification

Core follows its stated architecture; debt is on the `bin/` side.

- **A1 - pure logic lives in `bin/`.** `bin/commands/_workspace.ts` is a logic
  module (`buildServers`, `enabledServers`, `persist`, `parseAddSource` in
  `skill.ts`); the tell is `status.ts:55` re-implementing `enabledServers`
  byte-for-byte because `src/` can't import `bin/`. Move these into `src/`.
- **A2 - `add`/`edit` duplicate the wizard (~80%)** (object literal `add.ts:237`
  vs `edit.ts:173`, gh choices, Slack block, keychain validation). Extract a shared
  `buildWorkspace(...)` + `promptSlackDetails(current?)`.
- **A3 - the "No config found" guard is copy-pasted into 8 commands.** One
  `requireConfig()` helper.
- Minor: three workspace-resolver copies (`edit`/`remove`/`skill`); duplicated
  ".inscope still holds a login" note; `skillAdd` is a 170-line function to split.

Already clean: `io.ts` atomic writer, the pure-render/apply pairing, shared
`mergeMcpDoc`, `managed-block.ts`, `secrets.ts` Runner injection, `drift.ts` LCS.

### Portability (macOS/zsh -> Linux/bash)

One shell artifact (the hook) + one OS artifact (the Slack keychain), meeting at a
single line (`hook.ts:139`). Config is XDG-correct; git/gh/node/path and the
`.mcp.json` output are already portable.

| Combo         | State           | Remaining work                                                                                                          |
| ------------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Linux + zsh   | ~90%            | Only the Slack secret backend.                                                                                          |
| any OS + bash | hook won't load | New bash hook generator (`chpwd` -> `PROMPT_COMMAND`), rc-file/source/doctor generalization. `HOOK_UNSAFE` is reusable. |
| any OS + fish | hook won't load | Separate fish generator (`--on-variable PWD`) + own goldens.                                                            |

Sequence: Linux secret backend first, then bash, then fish (optional).

### UX / DX / docs

- **U1 - `skill` fallback help omits the shipped `rename`** (`skill.ts:505`). Stale-text bug.
- **U2 - README "13 one-click OAuth connectors" stale after Xquik** (`README.md:23`); `REMOTE` holds 14 including Xquik.
- **U3 - `add` help description omits the isolated login + skills** (`add.ts:37`).
- **U4 - first-run onboarding thin**: "regenerated" on a fresh run; never names the config file; doctor lacks the reload hint post-`add`.
- **U5 - `--json` only on `status`**; add to `doctor` (builds a typed `Check[]`) and `list`.
- **U6 - no shell completions** for 9 commands + a fixed 16-item `--servers` enum.
- **U7 - LOW (carried). non-interactive `add` with no path throws the whole help** as an error (`add.ts:103`); print a one-line "a path is required" instead.
- Minor: `--email` vs `--git-name` asymmetry; bare `inscope help`/`version` rejected.

Already polished: uniform "No config" onboarding, clean `init` removal, real
`--version`, type-the-label `rm`, `xquik` in the help/README list/config example.

## Recommended sequencing

1. Security (S1/S2) - done (#36).
2. Housekeeping PR - the quick wins (U1/U2/U3 doc bugs).
3. Diagnostic-tier tests - T1-T4 (guards the doctor; highest value-per-effort).
4. src/bin boundary + add/edit dedup - A1, A2.
5. A feature milestone - the inscope MCP server, or Linux + bash support (start
   with the Linux secret backend).

## Method & provenance

Five parallel auditors, one per dimension, each grounded in real `file:line`
references and asked to name what is already solid. S1 and the U1-U3 doc bugs were
re-verified against source; the prior 2026-06-13 audit was verified claim by claim
(table above). A point-in-time snapshot at v0.13.0 - verify line numbers still
hold before acting. Open items are tracked in issue #35.
